_format: One rule per stale or risky three.js API. pattern is a JavaScript regex source (flag g added by tw lint). since = the release that deprecated it (or removed it when there was no deprecation period); removed = the release that deleted it. status: removed | deprecated | pitfall. Severity is derived: error once the project's release is at or past `removed`, warn when deprecated, the rule's own severity for pitfalls. requires = a regex the file must match before the rule applies (for names that are only stale in a three.js context). sample must match the pattern and ok must not; tw kb validate checks both. verify = true means the release number still needs a primary-source check.

rules.message: the UMD builds build/three.js and build/three.min.js were removed in r160
rules.fix: load the ES module build through an import map ("three": ".../build/three.module.js") or a bundler
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r159 to r160

rules.message: the minified builds (three.module.min.js and friends) were removed in r186
rules.fix: import three.module.js or three.webgpu.js; CDNs and bundlers compress them
rules.source: npm three 0.185.1 build/ has *.min.js, 0.186.1 has none (checked 2026-09-26)

rules.message: the CommonJS build is deprecated since r186; three is ESM only going forward
rules.fix: import * as THREE from 'three' (set "type": "module" or use .mjs)

rules.message: examples/js (global-script addons) was removed in r148
rules.fix: import addons as modules from three/addons/... (examples/jsm)
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r147 to r148

rules.message: addons are not on the THREE namespace; the global-script versions were removed in r148
rules.fix: import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js' and call new OrbitControls(...)
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r147 to r148

rules.message: THREE.Geometry and Face3 were removed from core in r125
rules.fix: build a BufferGeometry with setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(array, 3))
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r124 to r125

rules.message: the *BufferGeometry aliases (BoxBufferGeometry and so on) were removed
rules.fix: use BoxGeometry, SphereGeometry and so on (they are BufferGeometry)
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide (release of removal to confirm)

rules.message: BufferGeometry.addAttribute() was renamed setAttribute()
rules.fix: geometry.setAttribute('position', attribute)

rules.message: applyMatrix() was renamed applyMatrix4()
rules.fix: object.applyMatrix4(matrix)

rules.message: THREE.Math was renamed THREE.MathUtils
rules.fix: THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(...), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(...)

rules.message: ImageUtils.loadTexture() was removed long ago
rules.fix: new THREE.TextureLoader().load(url) (set texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace for colour maps)

rules.message: JSONLoader (the old model format) was removed
rules.fix: convert models to glTF and use GLTFLoader

rules.message: renderer.gammaOutput, gammaInput and gammaFactor were removed; color management replaced them
rules.fix: leave renderer.outputColorSpace at SRGBColorSpace (the default) and tag colour textures with SRGBColorSpace

rules.message: the encoding API (outputEncoding, texture.encoding, sRGBEncoding, LinearEncoding) was replaced by color spaces in r152 and later removed
rules.fix: renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace (colour maps only)
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r151 to r152 (removal release to confirm)

rules.message: physicallyCorrectLights is gone; physically based light units are the only mode now
rules.fix: delete the line and retune light intensities (candela, lux) if the scene looks too dark

rules.message: useLegacyLights was removed; legacy light units are no longer available
rules.fix: delete the line and retune light intensities (point and spot lights often need about 4 pi times more)

rules.message: WebGL1Renderer and WebGL 1 support were removed
rules.fix: use WebGLRenderer (WebGL 2) or WebGPURenderer
rules.source: three.js Migration Guide r162 to r163 (to confirm)

rules.message: WebGLMultisampleRenderTarget was removed
rules.fix: new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { samples: 4 })

rules.message: WebGLMultipleRenderTargets was replaced by the count option of WebGLRenderTarget
rules.fix: new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { count: 3 }) and renderTarget.textures[i]

rules.message: ColorManagement.fromWorkingColorSpace() and toWorkingColorSpace() were renamed in r177
rules.fix: ColorManagement.workingToColorSpace() and ColorManagement.colorSpaceToWorking()

rules.message: USDZLoader is deprecated since r179
rules.fix: import { USDLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/USDLoader.js'

rules.message: RGBELoader is deprecated since r180
rules.fix: import { HDRLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/HDRLoader.js' (same usage)

rules.message: these *Async methods are deprecated since r181
rules.fix: await renderer.init() once after creating the renderer, then call render(), clear(), fromScene() and so on (compileAsync, computeAsync and readRenderTargetPixelsAsync stay valid)

rules.message: the TSL constant PI2 is deprecated since r181
rules.fix: TWO_PI

rules.message: the TSL node method cache() is deprecated since r181
rules.fix: isolate()
rules.sample: import { uv } from 'three/tsl'; const n = uv().cache();
rules.ok: import { uv } from 'three/tsl'; const n = uv().isolate();

rules.message: the TSL node method label() is deprecated since r179
rules.fix: setName()
rules.sample: import { uniform } from 'three/tsl'; const u = uniform(1).label('speed');
rules.ok: import { uniform } from 'three/tsl'; const u = uniform(1).setName('speed');

rules.message: transformedNormalView, transformedNormalWorld and transformedClearcoatNormalView are deprecated since r178
rules.fix: normalView, normalWorld, clearcoatNormalView

rules.message: these TSL functions were renamed in r185
rules.fix: directionToFaceDirection -> negateOnBackSide, directionToColor -> packNormalToRGB, colorToDirection -> unpackRGBToNormal

rules.message: premultipliedGaussianBlur() is deprecated since r180
rules.fix: gaussianBlur(node, sigma, { premultipliedAlpha: true })

rules.message: PassNode.setResolution() and getResolution() are deprecated since r181
rules.fix: setResolutionScale() and getResolutionScale()

rules.message: Line2NodeMaterial.lineColorNode is deprecated since r185
rules.fix: colorNode

rules.message: Renderer.getColorBufferType() is deprecated since r182
rules.fix: getOutputBufferType()

rules.message: SkyMesh.isSky is deprecated since r182
rules.fix: isSkyMesh

rules.message: VOXMesh is deprecated since r182
rules.fix: use the buildMesh() helper from VOXLoader.js

rules.message: THREE.Clock is deprecated since r183
rules.fix: const timer = new THREE.Timer(); timer.connect(document); each frame timer.update(time), then timer.getDelta() or timer.getElapsed()

rules.message: PostProcessing was renamed RenderPipeline in r183
rules.fix: const pipeline = new THREE.RenderPipeline(renderer); pipeline.outputNode = ...; pipeline.render()

rules.message: VTKLoader is deprecated since r184 and will be removed in r194
rules.fix: convert VTK files to glTF offline and load them with GLTFLoader

rules.message: LWOLoader is deprecated since r185 and will be removed in r195
rules.fix: convert LightWave files to glTF offline and load them with GLTFLoader

rules.message: SVGLoader.createShapes() is deprecated since r185
rules.fix: shapePath.toShapes(true)

rules.message: Source was renamed TextureSource in r186
rules.fix: new THREE.TextureSource(data); check isTextureSource

rules.message: PCFSoftShadowMap is deprecated since r186
rules.fix: renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap (soften with light.shadow.radius)

rules.message: three is loaded from a CDN without an exact version, so the page changes under you on the next release
rules.fix: pin it: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.module.js (and the same version for three/addons/)

rules.message: WebGPURenderer does not run GLSL ShaderMaterial or onBeforeCompile
rules.fix: write the material in TSL (MeshStandardNodeMaterial with colorNode and friends) or keep this page on WebGLRenderer
rules.sample: import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; const m = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({});
rules.ok: import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; const m = new THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial();

rules.message: EffectComposer and its passes are WebGL only
rules.fix: const pipeline = new THREE.RenderPipeline(renderer); pipeline.outputNode = pass(scene, camera) plus TSL display nodes (bloom, fxaa, ...)
rules.sample: import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
rules.ok: import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; const pipeline = new THREE.RenderPipeline(renderer);

rules.message: WebGPURenderer is created but never initialised: PMREM, compute and the first render need await renderer.init()
rules.fix: await renderer.init() after creating the renderer (or start with renderer.setAnimationLoop, which initialises it)
rules.sample: const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer(); renderer.render(scene, camera);
rules.ok: const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer(); await renderer.init();

rules.message: Renderer.waitForGPU() was removed in r181 (it now only logs an error)
rules.fix: await the promise of the operation you depend on (compute, readback) instead; see three.js issue 32012
rules.source: three/src/renderers/common/Renderer.js; first present in the r181 tag (raw.githubusercontent.com, checked 2026-09-26)

rules.message: DRACOExporter.parse() is deprecated since r185
rules.fix: const data = await exporter.parseAsync(mesh, options)
rules.sample: import { DRACOExporter } from 'three/addons/exporters/DRACOExporter.js'; const data = exporter.parse(mesh);
rules.ok: import { DRACOExporter } from 'three/addons/exporters/DRACOExporter.js'; const data = await exporter.parseAsync(mesh);

rules.message: DRACOLoader.setDecoderConfig() is deprecated since r185 and will be removed in r194
rules.fix: delete the call; the loader picks the decoder itself

rules.message: the GLSL chunk function inverseTransformDirection() is deprecated since r185
rules.fix: transformDirectionByInverseViewMatrix() (same arguments)

rules.message: FirstPersonControls.handleResize() was removed in r184; it is no longer needed
rules.fix: delete the call

rules.message: GTAONode distanceExponent and distanceFallOff do nothing since r186 (the new quadratic ray stepping does not need them)
rules.fix: delete them; tune radius, thickness and scale instead
